## Simulated GM12878 Trinity assembly

A benchmark on assembled transcripts whose true coding regions are known (`r evidence("E30")`;
scripts `pipeline/simtrinity/`, tables `data/simtrinity/`). Reads were simulated from annotated
transcripts only, at GM12878 expression levels, and assembled with the pipeline used for the real
GM12878 Trinity assembly (E11). So the input has the fragment, isoform and chimera structure of a real
genome-guided Trinity assembly, while every contig can be traced to its source transcript.

- **Transcripts simulated:** GENCODE v50 `protein_coding` transcripts with a complete CDS (no `*_NF`
  tags; ATG to stop, a whole number of codons, no internal stop) and all `lncRNA` transcripts. Nothing
  else: no pre-mRNA, retained-intron, NMD or pseudogene transcripts.
- **Expression:** salmon 1.10.3 counts (`ISR`, `--seqBias --gcBias`, full GENCODE v50 index) from the
  real reads (ENCSR000AED rep 1); the rounded counts of the kept transcripts are simulated.
- **Reads:** Polyester 1.38.0, paired 101 nt, `illumina5` errors, fragment length from salmon,
  stranded with read 1 antisense (dUTP/RF, as the real library).
- **Assembly:** STAR 2-pass (same index and parameters as the real run; run on methods02 for memory),
  Trinity 2.15.2 genome-guided (`--SS_lib_type RF --min_kmer_cov 2`), minimap2 `splice:hq` to GRCh38.
- **Labels** (`label_assembly.py`): a contig is compatible with a simulated transcript when their exons
  agree over the overlap (same introns; up to 10 nt of terminal overhang tolerated). The source CDS is
  projected onto compatible contigs, which are labelled complete, 5' partial, 3' partial or internal from
  the CDS ends they contain; contigs compatible only with lncRNAs and overlapping no GENCODE CDS are
  negatives. Contigs with conflicting projections (ambiguous), fewer than 50 codons (short) or no
  resolvable structure (unresolved) stay in the input, but predictions on them are not scored.
- **Scoring:** as for the other inputs (`score_predictions.py`): stop within 2 nt, exact when the start
  is also within 2 nt, one credit per truth CDS; every prediction on a negative is a false positive. The
  input is named `fragments_simtrinity.fa`, so `run_tool.sh` treats it as stranded and as fragments
  (RNAsamba partial-length weights); CPAT uses the human model. CodAn was not run (too slow) and
  `perl_td_v7` was not run (identical to `pytd_v7` on all other inputs; E08, E25).

```{r sim-data}
ST <- function(f) read_tab("simtrinity", f)
sim_par <- ST("sim_params.tsv") %>% { setNames(.[[2]], .[[1]]) }
sim_sel <- read_tsv(data_path("simtrinity", "selection_counts.tsv"), col_names = c("step", "n"), show_col_types = FALSE)
SEL <- setNames(sim_sel$n, sim_sel$step)
asm <- ST("assembly_stats.tsv")
ASM <- function(m, w = "simulated") asm[[w]][asm$metric == m]
LC <- ST("label_counts.tsv")
lc_n <- function(a, l) sum(LC$n[LC$assembly == a & LC$label %in% l])
SCORED_TYPES <- c("complete", "5prime_partial", "3prime_partial", "internal")
lab_tab <- LC %>% mutate(group = case_when(label %in% SCORED_TYPES ~ "coding (truth)", label == "noncoding" ~ "negative",
                                           TRUE ~ "not scored")) %>%
  group_by(assembly, group, label) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(assembly) %>% mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup()
kable(tibble(step = c("coding transcripts kept (complete CDS)", "lncRNA transcripts", "salmon pairs assigned (real reads)",
                      "simulated pairs (kept transcripts)", "  of which coding / lncRNA", "fragment length mean / sd",
                      "STAR uniquely mapped", "Trinity transcripts (simulated / real)", "Trinity 'genes' (simulated / real)",
                      "contigs with a primary alignment (simulated / real)"),
             value = c(num(SEL[["coding_kept"]]), num(SEL[["lncRNA"]]), num(as.numeric(sim_par[["salmon_num_mapped"]])),
                       num(as.numeric(sim_par[["pairs_total"]])),
                       paste(num(as.numeric(sim_par[["pairs_coding"]])), "/", num(as.numeric(sim_par[["pairs_lncRNA"]]))),
                       paste(sim_par[["fld_mean"]], "/", sim_par[["fld_sd"]]), paste0(ASM("star_unique_pct"), "%"),
                       paste(num(ASM("trinity_transcripts")), "/", num(ASM("trinity_transcripts", "real"))),
                       paste(num(ASM("trinity_genes")), "/", num(ASM("trinity_genes", "real"))),
                       paste(num(ASM("minimap2_primary_mapped")), "/", num(ASM("minimap2_primary_mapped", "real"))))),
      caption = "Simulation and assembly")
sg <- ST("strand_check_genome.tsv") %>% filter(mapping == "unique")
r1_anti <- sum(sg$n[sg$read == "R1" & sg$alignment_strand_vs_source == "opposite"]) / sum(sg$n[sg$read == "R1"])
```

**Strand.** In a 1% sample of the STAR alignments, uniquely mapped read 1 lies on the strand opposite
its source transcript in `r pct(r1_anti, 2)` of `r num(sum(sg$n[sg$read == "R1"]))` reads (RF, as the
real library).

**Labels.** The real GM12878 Trinity assembly was labelled with the same script against the same
transcript set, for comparison (its contigs come from all transcripts, pre-mRNA and unannotated
isoforms, so most are unresolved there).

```{r sim-labels}
kable(lab_tab %>% select(assembly, group, label, n) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = assembly, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
        mutate(simulated_frac = r3(simulated / sum(simulated)), real_frac = r3(real / sum(real))),
      caption = "Contig labels, simulated vs real Trinity GG assembly")
details(LC %>% filter(label %in% c("unresolved", "ambiguous")) %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = assembly, values_from = n, values_fill = 0), "unresolved and ambiguous by reason")
details(ST("incompatible_breakdown.tsv"), "simulated: why contigs are structurally incompatible")
pos_types <- function(a) { d <- LC %>% filter(assembly == a, label %in% SCORED_TYPES); setNames(d$n / sum(d$n), d$label) }
E29T <- ST("e29_five_prime.tsv")
n_unres_sim <- lc_n("simulated", "unresolved"); n_sim <- sum(LC$n[LC$assembly == "simulated"])
```

Of `r num(n_sim)` simulated contigs, `r num(lc_n("simulated", SCORED_TYPES))` carry a scored CDS,
`r num(lc_n("simulated", "noncoding"))` are negatives and `r num(n_unres_sim)` (`r pct(n_unres_sim / n_sim)`)
are unresolved. The two largest unresolved groups are contigs compatible with coding transcripts but
holding only UTR sequence (`r num(LC$n[LC$assembly == "simulated" & LC$reason == "utr_only"])`) and
contigs whose intron chain matches no single simulated transcript
(`r num(LC$n[LC$assembly == "simulated" & LC$reason == "incompatible"])`; half of them annotated introns
joined in new combinations by the assembler). Among the scored contigs, `r pct(pos_types("simulated")[["complete"]])`
are complete in the simulated assembly against `r pct(pos_types("real")[["complete"]])` in the real one.
The E29 statistic (contigs carrying a MANE Select stop with the reference structure to their 5' end
that begin inside the CDS) is `r pct(E29T$frac_5prime_partial[E29T$assembly == "simulated"])` simulated
vs `r pct(E29T$frac_5prime_partial[E29T$assembly == "real"])` real: the simulated assembly is more
complete than the real one (uniform coverage, no pre-mRNA, no degradation).

```{r sim-expr}
TBE <- ST("type_by_expr.tsv"); CBS <- ST("complete_by_source_expr.tsv")
TPM_BINS <- c("<1", "1-5", "5-20", "20-100", ">100")
kable(TBE %>% select(-n) %>% mutate(frac = r3(frac), tpm_bin = factor(tpm_bin, TPM_BINS)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = frac) %>%
        left_join(TBE %>% group_by(tpm_bin) %>% summarise(contigs = sum(n)), by = "tpm_bin") %>% arrange(tpm_bin),
      caption = "Scored contigs by salmon TPM of the source transcript(s): fraction of each type")
kable(CBS %>% mutate(across(starts_with("frac"), r3)),
      caption = "Simulated coding transcripts by TPM: with >= 1 complete contig, with >= 1 scored contig")
```

**Accuracy.** Predictions on unresolved, ambiguous and short contigs are removed before scoring
(counted in `n_pred_excluded`).

```{r sim-scores}
SIM_TOOLS <- c(pytd_v7 = "TransDecoder", perl_td_v600 = "TransDecoder v6.0.0", longest_orf = "longest ORF",
               prodigal = "Prodigal", gmst = "GeneMarkS-T", cpat = "CPAT", rnasamba = "RNAsamba", cpc2 = "CPC2",
               borf = "Borf")
so <- ST("scores_overall.tsv") %>% mutate(method = factor(SIM_TOOLS[tool], levels = SIM_TOOLS)) %>% arrange(method)
neg <- ST("negatives.tsv")
kable(so %>% left_join(neg %>% select(tool, frac_negatives_with_pred), by = "tool") %>%
        transmute(method, n_truth, n_pred, sensitivity_stop, precision_stop, f1_stop, sensitivity_exact,
                  precision_exact, f1_exact, negatives_with_pred = frac_negatives_with_pred, n_pred_excluded) %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.double), r3)),
      caption = "Simulated Trinity assembly: all scored contigs")
sbt <- ST("scores_by_type.tsv") %>% mutate(method = factor(SIM_TOOLS[tool], levels = SIM_TOOLS),
                                          type = factor(TYPE_LABEL[type], levels = TYPE_LABEL))
kable(sbt %>% transmute(method, type, v = sprintf("%.3f / %.3f", sensitivity_stop, sensitivity_exact)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = v) %>% arrange(method),
      caption = "Sensitivity by type, stop / exact")
sbe <- ST("scores_by_expr.tsv") %>% mutate(method = factor(SIM_TOOLS[tool], levels = SIM_TOOLS),
                                          tpm_bin = factor(tpm_bin, TPM_BINS))
kable(sbe %>% transmute(method, tpm_bin, v = sprintf("%.3f / %.3f", sensitivity_stop, sensitivity_exact)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = tpm_bin, values_from = v) %>% arrange(method),
      caption = "Sensitivity by TPM of the source transcript(s), stop / exact")
ex <- ST("excluded_preds.tsv")
details(ex %>% mutate(frac_with_pred = r3(frac_with_pred)) %>% select(tool, label, n_transcripts, with_pred, frac_with_pred) %>%
          pivot_wider(id_cols = c(label, n_transcripts), names_from = tool, values_from = frac_with_pred),
        "fraction of excluded contigs with a prediction, by label / reason")
pt_sim <- ST("pred_types.tsv")
details(pt_sim %>% filter(scope == "scored") %>% mutate(method = SIM_TOOLS[tool]) %>%
          select(method, n_pred, ends_with("_frac")) %>% mutate(across(ends_with("_frac"), r3)),
        "predicted ORF types (from each prediction's own ends), scored contigs")
SOV <- function(t, m) so[[m]][so$tool == t]
NEGV <- function(t) neg$frac_negatives_with_pred[neg$tool == t]
```

TransDecoder: stop-level F1 `r f3(SOV(TD, "f1_stop"))`, exact F1 `r f3(SOV(TD, "f1_exact"))`, with a
prediction on `r pct(NEGV(TD))` of the lncRNA-derived negatives. Prodigal finds more stops
(sensitivity `r f3(SOV("prodigal", "sensitivity_stop"))`) but predicts on `r pct(NEGV("prodigal"))` of
the negatives (exact F1 `r f3(SOV("prodigal", "f1_exact"))`); the longest-ORF baseline predicts on
`r pct(NEGV("longest_orf"))` of them. CPAT and RNAsamba reach stop F1 `r f3(SOV("cpat", "f1_stop"))` and
`r f3(SOV("rnasamba", "f1_stop"))` but cannot leave a 5' end open (exact sensitivity on 5' partials and
internal fragments below 0.02).

```{r figS-simtrinity, fig.width = FULL_W, fig.height = 85 * MM}
SIM_TYPE_LAB <- c(complete = "complete", `5prime_partial` = "5' partial", `3prime_partial` = "3' partial",
                  internal = "internal")
TYPE_COL <- c(complete = COMPLETE_C, `5' partial` = "#fd8d3c", `3' partial` = "#fdd0a2", internal = FRAG_C)
pa <- LC %>% filter(label %in% SCORED_TYPES) %>% group_by(assembly) %>% mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(type = factor(SIM_TYPE_LAB[label], levels = rev(SIM_TYPE_LAB)),
         assembly = factor(assembly, c("simulated", "real"), c("sim.", "real"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(assembly, frac, fill = type)) + geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = TYPE_COL, breaks = unname(SIM_TYPE_LAB), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), labels = percent) + labs(x = NULL, y = "scored contigs", title = "CDS type") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
pb <- so %>% left_join(neg, by = "tool") %>% select(method, f1_stop, f1_exact, frac_negatives_with_pred) %>%
  pivot_longer(-method) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, c("f1_stop", "f1_exact", "frac_negatives_with_pred"),
                       c("stop F1", "exact F1", "negatives\npredicted on")), method = factor(method, rev(SIM_TOOLS))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, method, fill = method == "TransDecoder")) + geom_col(width = 0.7) + facet_wrap(~name, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = TD_C, `FALSE` = GREY), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", "1"), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "all scored contigs")
pc <- sbe %>% filter(tool %in% c(TD, "prodigal", "gmst", "cpat", "longest_orf")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(tpm_bin, sensitivity_exact, colour = method, group = method)) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(TransDecoder = TD_C, Prodigal = "#d95f02", `GeneMarkS-T` = "#7570b3", CPAT = "#1b9e77",
                                 `longest ORF` = GREY), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "source TPM", y = "exact sensitivity", title = "by expression") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)) + guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
figS_sim <- (pa + pb + pc) + plot_layout(widths = c(0.6, 2, 1.5)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_fig(figS_sim, "figS_simtrinity", FULL_W, 85 * MM)
figS_sim
```

### Read-depth ablation

At full depth the simulated assembly is mostly complete CDSs (above), so partial CDSs are few. To get
more partial contigs, the E30 STAR alignments were subsampled by read pair to 1/2, 1/4, ... of the
pairs (`samtools view --subsample`, one seed, so the levels are nested), and each level was assembled,
labelled, run and scored exactly as at full depth (`r evidence("E31")`; scripts `11_depth_subsample.sh`,
`08b_trinity_gg_level.sh`, `12_depth_label_and_run.sh`, `13_depth_collect.py`; tables
`data/simtrinity/depth/`). STAR was not re-run, so the two-pass junctions come from the full read set
(they are annotated junctions anyway).

```{r depth-data}
DP <- function(f) read_tab("simtrinity", "depth", f)
dlev <- DP("levels.tsv") %>% mutate(fraction = as.numeric(fraction))
LEV_LAB <- setNames(ifelse(dlev$fraction == 1, "1", paste0("1/", round(1 / dlev$fraction))), dlev$level)
dtc <- DP("truth_counts.tsv") %>% mutate(reads = LEV_LAB[level])
kable(dlev %>% transmute(level, `read pairs` = num(as.numeric(pairs)), `observed fraction` = observed_fraction,
                         `Trinity transcripts` = num(trinity_transcripts)) %>%
        left_join(dtc %>% select(level, complete, `5' partial` = `5prime_partial`, `3' partial` = `3prime_partial`, internal,
                                 truth = truth_total, negatives, unresolved), by = "level"),
      caption = "Depth levels: read pairs, assembly size and labels")
# shares from the counts (not from the rounded share_* columns), rounded once for display
dsh <- dtc %>% transmute(reads, s_c = complete / truth_total, s_5 = `5prime_partial` / truth_total,
                         s_3 = `3prime_partial` / truth_total, s_i = internal / truth_total)
kable(dsh %>% transmute(reads, complete = pct(s_c), `5' partial` = pct(s_5), `3' partial` = pct(s_3), internal = pct(s_i),
                        `largest change from previous level (points)` =
                          c(NA, f1(100 * apply(abs(diff(as.matrix(select(dsh, -reads)))), 1, max)))),
      caption = "Share of each CDS type among the scored truth, by level (stop rule: every share changes by < 3 points)")
de29 <- DP("e29_five_prime.tsv")
details(de29 %>% mutate(frac_5prime_partial = r3(frac_5prime_partial)), "E29 statistic by level")
details(DP("label_counts.tsv") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = n, values_fill = 0),
        "all labels and reasons by level")
dbt <- DP("scores_by_type.tsv") %>% mutate(method = factor(SIM_TOOLS[tool], levels = SIM_TOOLS),
                                          type = factor(SIM_TYPE_LAB[type], levels = SIM_TYPE_LAB),
                                          reads = factor(LEV_LAB[level], levels = LEV_LAB))
dov <- DP("scores_overall.tsv") %>% left_join(DP("negatives.tsv") %>% select(level, tool, frac_negatives_with_pred),
                                              by = c("level", "tool")) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(SIM_TOOLS[tool], levels = SIM_TOOLS), reads = factor(LEV_LAB[level], levels = LEV_LAB))
best_of <- function(col) dbt %>% filter(tool != TD) %>% group_by(reads, type) %>%
  slice_max(.data[[col]], n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  transmute(reads, type, v = sprintf("%.3f (%s)", .data[[col]], method))
kable(dbt %>% filter(tool == TD) %>% transmute(reads, type, n_truth, `TransDecoder, with negatives` = r3(f1_exact_wneg)) %>%
        left_join(best_of("f1_exact_wneg") %>% rename(`best other, with negatives` = v), by = c("reads", "type")) %>%
        left_join(dbt %>% filter(tool == TD) %>% transmute(reads, type, `TransDecoder, truth only` = r3(f1_exact)),
                  by = c("reads", "type")) %>%
        left_join(best_of("f1_exact") %>% rename(`best other, truth only` = v), by = c("reads", "type")) %>%
        arrange(type, reads),
      caption = "Exact F1 by CDS type: TransDecoder vs the best other method. Precision counts the predictions on contigs of that type; 'with negatives' also counts predictions on negatives whose own ORF is of that type")
details(DP("neg_pred_types.tsv") %>% mutate(reads = LEV_LAB[level], method = SIM_TOOLS[tool]) %>%
          select(reads, method, n_pred_on_negatives, all_of(SCORED_TYPES)), "predictions on negatives by their own ORF type")
details(dov %>% transmute(reads, method, n_truth, f1_stop = r3(f1_stop), f1_exact = r3(f1_exact),
                          negatives_with_pred = r3(frac_negatives_with_pred)) %>% arrange(reads, method),
        "overall stop / exact F1 and negatives with a prediction, by level and method")
details(dbt %>% transmute(reads, method, type, n_truth, sensitivity_stop = r3(sensitivity_stop),
                          sensitivity_exact = r3(sensitivity_exact), f1_exact = r3(f1_exact),
                          f1_exact_wneg = r3(f1_exact_wneg)) %>% arrange(type, reads, method),
        "by type: sensitivity and exact F1, by level and method")
```

```{r depth-text}
DTV <- function(lev, tool, type, m) dbt[[m]][dbt$level == lev & dbt$tool == tool & dbt$type == SIM_TYPE_LAB[[type]]]
DOV <- function(lev, tool, m) dov[[m]][dov$level == lev & dov$tool == tool]
LAST <- tail(dlev$level, 1)
```

Halving the reads down to `r LEV_LAB[[LAST]]` of the pairs shifts the scored truth from
`r pct(dsh$s_c[1])` complete to `r pct(dsh$s_c[nrow(dsh)])` complete, and internal fragments from
`r pct(dsh$s_i[1])` to `r pct(dsh$s_i[nrow(dsh)])`. The ablation was stopped at `r LEV_LAB[[LAST]]` (Brian,
2026-10-27); the type shares had not stabilised (largest change at the last step
`r f1(100 * max(abs(unlist(dsh[nrow(dsh), -1]) - unlist(dsh[nrow(dsh) - 1, -1]))))` points), and the 5' and 3'
partial counts had begun to fall with the total. TransDecoder's exact F1 (with negatives) on 5' partials rises from
`r f3(DTV("d1", TD, "5prime_partial", "f1_exact_wneg"))` at full depth to
`r f3(DTV(LAST, TD, "5prime_partial", "f1_exact_wneg"))`, and on internal fragments from
`r f3(DTV("d1", TD, "internal", "f1_exact_wneg"))` to `r f3(DTV(LAST, TD, "internal", "f1_exact_wneg"))`; its
overall exact F1 is `r f3(DOV("d1", TD, "f1_exact"))` and `r f3(DOV(LAST, TD, "f1_exact"))`, with predictions on
`r pct(DOV("d1", TD, "frac_negatives_with_pred"))` and `r pct(DOV(LAST, TD, "frac_negatives_with_pred"))` of the
negatives (Prodigal `r pct(DOV(LAST, "prodigal", "frac_negatives_with_pred"))`, longest ORF
`r pct(DOV(LAST, "longest_orf", "frac_negatives_with_pred"))` at `r LEV_LAB[[LAST]]`).

Fig. S (`figS_simtrinity_depth`): one line per method across depth. The four per-type panels show exact F1
with predictions on negatives counted toward that type's precision (`f1_exact_wneg`; each prediction on a
negative is typed by its own ORF). Overall exact F1 and the fraction of negatives with a prediction are also shown.
Per-type exact sensitivity, which ignores the negatives, is in the second figure (`figS_simtrinity_depth_sens`).

```{r figS-depth, fig.width = FULL_W, fig.height = 110 * MM}
DEPTH_COL <- c(TransDecoder = TD_C, `TransDecoder v6.0.0` = "#6baed6", `longest ORF` = GREY, Prodigal = "#d95f02",
               `GeneMarkS-T` = "#7570b3", CPAT = "#1b9e77", RNAsamba = "#e7298a", CPC2 = "#e6ab02", Borf = "#222222")
lev_frac <- function(l) dlev$fraction[match(l, dlev$level)]
depth_plot <- function(d) {
  ggplot(d, aes(fraction, value, colour = method)) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(size = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, nrow = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2", breaks = dlev$fraction, labels = LEV_LAB[dlev$level]) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = DEPTH_COL, name = NULL) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "fraction of simulated read pairs", y = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "#e5e5e5")) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
}
F1_PANELS <- c(paste0(SIM_TYPE_LAB, ": exact F1 (with negatives)"), "all: exact F1", "negatives with a prediction")
dpanel <- bind_rows(
  dbt %>% transmute(fraction = lev_frac(level), method, panel = paste0(type, ": exact F1 (with negatives)"), value = f1_exact_wneg),
  dov %>% transmute(fraction = lev_frac(level), method, panel = "all: exact F1", value = f1_exact),
  dov %>% transmute(fraction = lev_frac(level), method, panel = "negatives with a prediction", value = frac_negatives_with_pred)) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, F1_PANELS))
figS_depth <- depth_plot(dpanel)
save_fig(figS_depth, "figS_simtrinity_depth", FULL_W, 110 * MM)
figS_depth
```

```{r figS-depth-sens, fig.width = FULL_W, fig.height = 110 * MM}
SENS_PANELS <- c(paste0(SIM_TYPE_LAB, ": exact sens."), paste0(SIM_TYPE_LAB, ": stop sens."))
dsens <- bind_rows(
  dbt %>% transmute(fraction = lev_frac(level), method, panel = paste0(type, ": exact sens."), value = sensitivity_exact),
  dbt %>% transmute(fraction = lev_frac(level), method, panel = paste0(type, ": stop sens."), value = sensitivity_stop)) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, SENS_PANELS))
figS_depth_sens <- depth_plot(dsens) + facet_wrap(~panel, nrow = 2, ncol = 4)
save_fig(figS_depth_sens, "figS_simtrinity_depth_sens", FULL_W, 110 * MM)
figS_depth_sens
```

## Simulated Arabidopsis Trinity assembly

The E30/E31 design repeated for *A. thaliana* (`r evidence("E32")`; scripts `pipeline/simtrinity_athal/`, tables
`data/simtrinity_athal/`). Transcripts: TAIR12 (the annotation of the main benchmark) protein-coding transcripts
with a complete CDS, plus lncRNA and antisense_RNA transcripts that overlap no same-strand CDS as negatives.
Expression: salmon on a stranded (dUTP) Col-0 leaf library (ENA ERR4140056, 2 x 100 nt). Reads: Polyester,
as E30. Assembly: STAR two-pass on a TAIR12 index, genome-guided Trinity 2.15.2 and minimap2 with the E30
parameters. Labels, tools (organism `athal`: TransDecoder `-G Universal`; CPAT, CPC2 and RNAsamba with their
human models) and scoring as E30/E31, at full depth (d1) and at 1/2 ... of the read pairs.

```{r at-data}
AT <- function(...) read_tab("simtrinity_athal", ...)
at_sel <- read_tsv(data_path("simtrinity_athal", "selection_counts.tsv"), col_names = c("step", "n"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ATSEL <- setNames(at_sel$n, at_sel$step)
at_par <- AT("sim_params.tsv") %>% { setNames(.[[2]], .[[1]]) }
alev <- AT("depth", "levels.tsv") %>% mutate(fraction = as.numeric(fraction))
ALEV_LAB <- setNames(ifelse(alev$fraction == 1, "1", paste0("1/", round(1 / alev$fraction))), alev$level)
atc <- AT("depth", "truth_counts.tsv") %>% mutate(reads = ALEV_LAB[level])
kable(tibble(step = c("coding transcripts kept (complete CDS)", "negatives kept (lncRNA / antisense_RNA)",
                      "salmon pairs assigned (real reads)", "simulated pairs (coding / negatives)",
                      "fragment length mean / sd"),
             value = c(num(ATSEL[["coding_kept"]]),
                       paste(num(ATSEL[["neg_kept:lncRNA"]]), "/", num(ATSEL[["neg_kept:antisense_RNA"]])),
                       num(as.numeric(at_par[["salmon_num_mapped"]])),
                       paste(num(as.numeric(at_par[["pairs_coding"]])), "/", num(as.numeric(at_par[["pairs_lncRNA"]]))),
                       paste(at_par[["fld_mean"]], "/", at_par[["fld_sd"]]))),
      caption = "Arabidopsis: transcript set and simulation")
ash <- atc %>% transmute(reads, s_c = complete / truth_total, s_5 = `5prime_partial` / truth_total,
                         s_3 = `3prime_partial` / truth_total, s_i = internal / truth_total)
kable(alev %>% transmute(level, `read pairs` = num(as.numeric(pairs)), `Trinity transcripts` = num(trinity_transcripts)) %>%
        left_join(atc %>% select(level, complete, `5' partial` = `5prime_partial`, `3' partial` = `3prime_partial`, internal,
                                 truth = truth_total, negatives, unresolved), by = "level") %>%
        left_join(ash %>% transmute(level = names(ALEV_LAB)[match(reads, ALEV_LAB)],
                                    `complete / 5' / 3' / internal (%)` = paste(f1(100 * s_c), f1(100 * s_5), f1(100 * s_3), f1(100 * s_i), sep = " / ")),
                  by = "level"),
      caption = "Arabidopsis: assembly size and labels by depth level")
details(AT("depth", "label_counts.tsv") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = n, values_fill = 0),
        "Arabidopsis: all labels and reasons by level")
abt <- AT("depth", "scores_by_type.tsv") %>% mutate(method = factor(SIM_TOOLS[tool], levels = SIM_TOOLS),
                                                   type = factor(SIM_TYPE_LAB[type], levels = SIM_TYPE_LAB),
                                                   reads = factor(ALEV_LAB[level], levels = ALEV_LAB))
aov <- AT("depth", "scores_overall.tsv") %>%
  left_join(AT("depth", "negatives.tsv") %>% select(level, tool, frac_negatives_with_pred), by = c("level", "tool")) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(SIM_TOOLS[tool], levels = SIM_TOOLS), reads = factor(ALEV_LAB[level], levels = ALEV_LAB))
kable(aov %>% filter(level == "d1") %>% arrange(method) %>%
        transmute(method, n_truth, sensitivity_stop, precision_stop, f1_stop, sensitivity_exact, precision_exact, f1_exact,
                  negatives_with_pred = frac_negatives_with_pred, n_pred_excluded) %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), r3)),
      caption = "Arabidopsis, full depth: all scored contigs")
anc <- AT("depth", "negatives_by_class.tsv") %>% filter(level == "d1") %>% mutate(method = SIM_TOOLS[tool])
kable(anc %>% select(class, n_negatives, method, frac_with_pred) %>% mutate(frac_with_pred = r3(frac_with_pred)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = frac_with_pred),
      caption = "Arabidopsis, full depth: negatives with a prediction, by source class ('both': compatible with transcripts of both classes)")
details(AT("depth", "negatives_by_class.tsv") %>% mutate(frac_with_pred = r3(frac_with_pred)),
        "Arabidopsis: negatives by class, all levels")
abest <- function(col) abt %>% filter(tool != TD) %>% group_by(reads, type) %>%
  slice_max(.data[[col]], n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  transmute(reads, type, v = sprintf("%.3f (%s)", .data[[col]], method))
kable(abt %>% filter(tool == TD) %>% transmute(reads, type, n_truth, `TransDecoder, with negatives` = r3(f1_exact_wneg)) %>%
        left_join(abest("f1_exact_wneg") %>% rename(`best other, with negatives` = v), by = c("reads", "type")) %>%
        arrange(type, reads),
      caption = "Arabidopsis: exact F1 by CDS type (negatives counted), TransDecoder vs the best other method")
details(aov %>% transmute(reads, method, f1_stop = r3(f1_stop), f1_exact = r3(f1_exact),
                          negatives_with_pred = r3(frac_negatives_with_pred)) %>% arrange(reads, method),
        "Arabidopsis: overall F1 and negatives with a prediction, by level and method")
details(abt %>% transmute(reads, method, type, n_truth, sensitivity_exact = r3(sensitivity_exact),
                          f1_exact = r3(f1_exact), f1_exact_wneg = r3(f1_exact_wneg)) %>% arrange(type, reads, method),
        "Arabidopsis: by type, by level and method")
```

**What this assembly tests.** The expression levels are those of the real leaf library (Brian, 2026-10-28: the
noncoding RNAs were not boosted). The lncRNA and antisense_RNA transcripts carry only
`r pct(as.numeric(at_par[["pairs_lncRNA"]]) / as.numeric(at_par[["pairs_total"]]))` of the simulated reads, so few
negative contigs assemble (`r num(atc$negatives[1])` at full depth, falling with depth). This simulation is therefore
mainly a test of frame and end placement on assembled coding transcripts, not of rejecting noncoding sequence; the
noncoding test is the human simulation (E30/E31) and the lncRNA inputs of the main benchmark (E04).


**Homology mode.** TransDecoder (PyTD a5b24c3, `r evidence("E33")`) on each depth level of both simulations
in three conditions on the same LongOrfs: A ab initio; B homology mode (DIAMOND `-k 1 -e 1e-5` against Swiss-Prot
without the organism's own entries, `sprot_minus_9606` / `sprot_minus_3702`, and `hmmsearch --cut_ga` against Pfam-A,
on all LongOrfs peptides) with the homology start assist (the default when hits are supplied); C the same hits with
`--no-homology-start-assist`. Condition A equals the release TransDecoder rows above. Scripts
`pipeline/start_classifier/17_*`-`22_*`; tables `data/start_classifier/adoption/{human,athal}_depth_scores.tsv`.

```{r depth-homology}
HOM_COND <- c(TD_A_abinitio = "A ab initio", TD_B_homology_assist = "B homology + start assist",
              TD_C_homology_noassist = "C homology, no start assist")
hds <- bind_rows(
  read_tab("start_classifier", "adoption", "human_depth_scores.tsv") %>% mutate(species = "human"),
  read_tab("start_classifier", "adoption", "athal_depth_scores.tsv") %>% mutate(species = "A. thaliana")) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species, c("human", "A. thaliana")))
hds_lab <- function(sp, lv) ifelse(sp == "human", LEV_LAB[lv], ALEV_LAB[lv])
kable(hds %>% filter(method %in% names(HOM_COND)) %>%
        transmute(species, reads = hds_lab(species, level), lv = as.integer(sub("d", "", level)), condition = HOM_COND[method],
                  `all: exact F1` = r3(f1_exact), `all: stop F1` = r3(f1_stop),
                  complete = r3(f1_exact_wneg_complete), `5' partial` = r3(f1_exact_wneg_5prime_partial),
                  `3' partial` = r3(f1_exact_wneg_3prime_partial), internal = r3(f1_exact_wneg_internal)) %>%
        arrange(species, lv, condition) %>% select(-lv),
      caption = "TransDecoder ab initio (A), homology mode with (B) and without (C) the start assist: exact F1 overall and per CDS type (per type: negatives counted)")
kable(hds %>% filter(species == "human", method %in% names(HOM_COND)) %>%
        transmute(reads = LEV_LAB[level], lv = as.integer(sub("d", "", level)), condition = HOM_COND[method],
                  v = sprintf("%s / %s", num(negatives_with_pred), num(n_negatives))) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = v) %>% arrange(lv) %>% select(-lv),
      caption = "Human: lncRNA-only contigs (negatives) with a prediction / negatives, by condition")
```

**Human vs Arabidopsis.** Exact F1 per CDS type (negatives counted) and overall, by depth level, for both
simulations (human: E30/E31, above). Dashed: TransDecoder in homology mode with the start assist (condition B above).

```{r figS-athal, fig.width = FULL_W, fig.height = 120 * MM}
HOM_LAB <- "TransDecoder + homology"
hom <- hds %>% filter(method == "TD_B_homology_assist") %>%
  transmute(species, fraction = ifelse(species == "human", lev_frac(level), alev$fraction[match(level, alev$level)]),
            f1_exact, complete = f1_exact_wneg_complete, `5prime_partial` = f1_exact_wneg_5prime_partial,
            `3prime_partial` = f1_exact_wneg_3prime_partial, internal = f1_exact_wneg_internal) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(species, fraction), names_to = "panel", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(panel = ifelse(panel == "f1_exact", "all", SIM_TYPE_LAB[panel]), method = HOM_LAB, species = as.character(species))
both <- bind_rows(
  dbt %>% transmute(species = "human", fraction = lev_frac(level), method, panel = as.character(type), value = f1_exact_wneg),
  dov %>% transmute(species = "human", fraction = lev_frac(level), method, panel = "all", value = f1_exact),
  abt %>% transmute(species = "A. thaliana", fraction = alev$fraction[match(level, alev$level)], method,
                    panel = as.character(type), value = f1_exact_wneg),
  aov %>% transmute(species = "A. thaliana", fraction = alev$fraction[match(level, alev$level)], method, panel = "all",
                    value = f1_exact)) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method)) %>% bind_rows(hom) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, c(SIM_TYPE_LAB, "all"), c(SIM_TYPE_LAB, "all contigs")),
         species = factor(species, c("human", "A. thaliana")),
         method = factor(method, c(SIM_TOOLS, HOM_LAB)))
HOM_COL <- c(DEPTH_COL, setNames(TD_C, HOM_LAB))
HOM_LTY <- setNames(c(rep("solid", length(DEPTH_COL)), "22"), names(HOM_COL))
figS_athal <- ggplot(both, aes(fraction, value, colour = method, linetype = method)) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(species ~ panel) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2", breaks = c(1, 1/4, 1/16), labels = c("1", "1/4", "1/16")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = HOM_COL, name = NULL) + scale_linetype_manual(values = HOM_LTY, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "fraction of simulated read pairs", y = "exact F1 (per type: negatives counted)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "#e5e5e5")) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2), linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
save_fig(figS_athal, "figS_simtrinity_athal", FULL_W, 120 * MM)
figS_athal
```

## Checks against the manuscript

Each row compares a value computed here with the value in the text now. Labels give the tex file and
line (`mb` = `methods_benchmark.tex`, `rb` = `results_benchmark.tex`, `fm` = `figures_main.tex`).
TransDecoder values are from the release runs, so TransDecoder mismatches are expected until the text
is updated (see the previous section for the earlier values).

```{r checks}
# Methods
for (o in ORGS) check_text(sprintf("mb:32-39 genes, %s", ORG_LABEL[[o]]), genes$n_truth[genes$org == o], GENES_TEX[[o]])
check_text("mb:82 inputs per organism", unique(per_org$n), 10)
check_text("mb:84 human lncRNA negatives", n_lnc[["human"]], 33668)
check_text("mb:85 mouse lncRNA negatives", n_lnc[["mouse"]], 31467)
check_text("mb:85 inputs in total", N_INPUTS, 84)
check_text("mb:93 v5.7.1 = v6.0.0, inputs", sum(v6_same$same), 80)
check_text("mb:120 ANGEL runs", nrow(angel), 3)
check_text("mb:120 ANGEL hours, min", floor(min(angel$hours)), 17)
check_text("mb:120 ANGEL hours, max", round(max(angel$hours)), 22)
# Table 1 (rb:24-32)
TEX_T1 <- tribble(~tool, ~line, ~v1, ~v2, ~v3, ~v4, ~v5,
  "pytd_v7", 24, 0.980, 0.912, 0.930, 0.822, 0.994,
  "perl_td_v600", 25, 0.972, 0.779, 0.869, 0.715, 0.995,
```
